orderingMemory.bound: At most 262,144 normalized keys overall; normal leaves restrict keys to 3^9 = 19,683. The sampled delta also includes retained search/JIT and board storage. limits: D2 Elo compares the final engine with the original commit. D3 and D4 Elo isolate evaluation weights against already improved engines. These cannot be added.
All Elo figures are descriptive for the stated board, opponent, openings and requested budget. Production 8.5-second Elo was not measured.
The four pre-D4-change full games are legality/restoration smoke coverage; the D4 strategy trials separately record 20 tuning and 20 confirmation games.
Original D2 baseline exceeds requested deadlines and receives more actual computation. Search timing excludes board import and UI rendering.
Exact D1 outcome and optimal mate-distance validation is exhaustive. D2-D4 exact endgames are sampled; the saved D3/D4 exact cases are all draws.
Fixed-depth speedups describe six sampled positions per board; opening speedups use three alternating runs. No universal position speedup is claimed.
Isolated hot-path experiments report their controlled snapshots; their speedups are not assumed additive.
Earlier measurements retain their own source fingerprints in historicalStage and are not relabeled as final.
Absolute maximum Elo or global D2-D4 optimality has not been proven.

projectTypecheck.limitation: Existing React/JSX and graphics diagnostics; same total as Stage3. Stage3 compared original265/current255 with no new diagnostic kinds. This run does not claim a fresh diagnostic-kind comparison.

readOnlyReview.performance: No correctness blocker found; exact Draw/color rank normalization, packing ceiling, initialization, and routing arithmetic reviewed.
readOnlyReview.frontier: No blocker for normalized worker inputs. A raw alphaBeta depth0 diagnostic supplied an unnormalized stale closed constraint can miss a win; adapter imports and played children normalize. This cannot create a false winning proof.
readOnlyReview.verifiers: Independent review found no blockers: separate expected results, once-only default integration, bounded test-only work, full private-cache leaf restoration, and frozen19-file runtime identity confirmed.

limits: Timing suites are finite samples, measured sequentially; speedups are not universal.
Pure-performance comparisons assert identical score, move and nodes. Exact frontier win extension can change the nominal-depth search tree.
Node cold readiness includes compiled module loading and first Search/Board construction, not browser worker startup or UI rendering.
Rank tables add878582 bytes per JavaScript realm; total browser resident memory was not measured.
Selfplay Elo and score intervals apply only to the stated source pair, seed, board size and budget. Production8.5-second Elo remains unmeasured.
Historical Stage3 results measure its own2bb7e3199f9a source, not this new source; previous Elo estimates cannot be added.
Existing full-project React/graphics TypeScript errors remain; focused strict AI checks pass.
No absolute maximum Elo or general D2–D4 optimality is claimed.
